title: porter IR document
description: Declarative part of a mod as version-neutral data. Logic is never serialized here: nodes reference logic classes (logicClass, handlerClass) that go through the rewriter. See contracts/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: 2 since RFC 003 (recipe IO for viewers, hidden objects); documents without the RFC 003 fields may stay at 1 (semantic check: RFC 003 fields need 2).

platformVersion.description: Loader + Minecraft version, e.g. forge-1.19.2, forge-1.7.10.

resourceId.description: Namespaced resource location 'namespace:path'. The namespace is always explicit (minecraft:air, not air).

className.description: Fully qualified Java class name in the source version, binary form for nested classes (a.b.Outer$Inner).

texturePath.description: Texture resource 'namespace:path' relative to textures/, without extension (examplemod:block/press_front).

file.description: Path relative to the mod source root, or 'runtime:<what>' for runtime exports.

via.description: How the fact was obtained. Default: source.

extractor.description: Extractor that produced the node, e.g. 'block/deferred-register'.

base.description: Common fields of every concept node.

id.description: Concept id. A namespaced resourceId for every kind except mod (bare mod id).

extensions.description: Free-form, namespaced data that no concept field covers yet (key = '<owner>:<name>'). Consumers must ignore unknown keys.

mod.description: Mod metadata. id is the bare mod id (examplemod).

logicClass.description: Custom Block subclass with logic; absent for plain blocks.

stateProperties.description: Block state properties. Generators for meta-based versions lay these out into metadata (or a TileEntity field if > 16 states).

textures.description: Resolved textures per face (from the block model). 'all' is shorthand for every face.

blockEntity.description: Id of the blockEntity node attached to this block.

item.description: Id of the item node that places this block, if any.

hidden.description: RFC 003: internal/technical object players never handle (e.g. a multiblock part placed by code, a debug item); recipe viewers and creative search hide it. Default false.

containerItem.description: Item left after crafting use (bucket, glass bottle...).

hidden.description: RFC 003: internal/technical object players never handle (e.g. a multiblock part placed by code, a debug item); recipe viewers and creative search hide it. Default false.

logicClass.description: BlockEntity class with the logic; goes through the rewriter.

menu.description: Menu opened by this block entity, if any.

nbt.description: Persisted NBT keys (for scenario sampling and key mapping between versions).

chance.description: RFC 003: probability of this output (custom recipes), default 1.

fluidStack.description: RFC 003: an amount of a fluid, in mB.

ingredient.description: One of: an item, a tag (mapped to OreDictionary on 1.7.10 via the tag node), or alternatives.

recipeNote.description: RFC 003: a line shown with the recipe in recipe viewers: plain text, or a translation key with its English text.

customType.description: Machine/custom recipe type id; required when recipeType = custom.

results.description: For custom recipes with several outputs.

duration.description: RFC 003: processing time of a custom recipe in ticks at base speed (machine time, ageing time...).

machines.description: RFC 003: blocks/items that perform the recipe (recipe-viewer catalysts and tab icon), first = main machine.

notes.description: RFC 003: conditions and explanations shown with the recipe (ranges, ageing, quality rules...).

data.description: Extra parameters of custom recipe types (energy, time, chances...).

menu.description: GUI: container slots + screen layout. Coordinates are pixels relative to the GUI background's top-left corner.

logicClass.description: Menu/Container class, if it has logic beyond the slot layout.

slots.description: Machine slots (container indices 0..n-1). Player inventory is given by playerInventory, not listed here.

playerInventory.description: Top-left of the standard 9x3 player inventory; hotbar assumed 58 px below unless hotbarY is given.

bars.description: Progress bars/gauges (шкалы): target rect on screen, sprite (u,v) in the texture, fill direction, value source.

value.description: dataSlots name holding the current value.

max.description: Max value: an integer or a dataSlots name.

packet.description: Packet sent on click, if any.

handlerClass.description: Handler logic; goes through the rewriter.

lang.description: One locale of one namespace. id = '<namespace>:<locale>'.

sound.description: Sound event. id = sound event id.

name.description: Sound file relative to sounds/, no extension.

logicClass.description: Effect class with per-tick logic, if any.

oneOf.description: Wildcard: any block is accepted at this position.

multiblock.description: Structure as data. size = [x, y, z]. layers are bottom-to-top (y), each layer is z rows, each row a string of x palette chars. Positions are relative to the structure's min corner. Dimension consistency is a semantic check (see README).

facing.description: Facing of the controller in the canonical orientation.

tag.description: Tag (id = tag id without '#'), with mapping to OreDictionary names for 1.7.10.

oreDict.description: OreDictionary names this tag maps to (e.g. ingotCopper). Empty = no mapping.

unknown.description: Anything an extractor recognised as declarative but could not classify with certainty. Never guess: emit this instead.

conceptHint.description: Concept the extractor suspects, if any.
